arxiv-2106-10208.title: Fiber-based biphoton source with ultrabroad frequency tunability
arxiv-2106-10208.creator: Santiago Lopez-Huidobro 1 , 2 , ∗ \textrm{Santiago Lopez-Huidobro}^{1,2,^{*}} , Markus Lippl 1 , 2 \textrm{Markus Lippl}^{1,2} , Nicolas Y. Joly 1 , 2 , 3 \textrm{Nicolas Y. Joly}^{1,2,3} , Maria V. Chekhova 1 , 2 \textrm{Maria V. Chekhova}^{1,2}
arxiv-2106-10208.description: Abstract Tunable biphotons are highly important for a wide range of quantum applications. For some applications, especially interesting are cases where two photons of a pair are far apart in frequency. Here, we report a tunable biphoton source based on a xenon-filled hollow-core photonic crystal fiber. Tunability is achieved by adjusting the pressure of the gas inside the fiber.

arxiv-2106-12677.title: Optimal estimation of coarse structural nested mean models with application to initiating ART in HIV infected patients
arxiv-2106-12677.creator: Judith J. Lok
arxiv-2106-12677.description: Abstract Abstract Coarse structural nested mean models are used to estimate treatment effects from longitudinal observational data. Coarse structural nested mean models lead to a large class of estimators. It turns out that estimates and standard errors may differ considerably within this class.

arxiv-2108-12327.title: : Combinatorial and Complexity Results
arxiv-2108-12327.creator: Sujoy Bhore, Giordano Da Lozzo, Fabrizio Montecchiani, Martin Nöllenburg
arxiv-2108-12327.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Sujoy Bhore, Giordano Da Lozzo, Fabrizio Montecchiani, Martin Nöllenburg. A long-standing conjecture by Heath, Pemmaraju, and Trenk states that the upward book thickness of outerplanar DAGs is bounded above by a constant. In this paper, we show that the conjecture holds for subfamilies of upward outerplanar graphs, namely those whose underlying graph is an internally-triangulated outerpath or a cactus, and those whose biconnected components are s ​ t st -outerplanar graphs.

The wealth and homogeneity of Gaia data have allowed the discovery of several open clusters with signs of disruption. arxiv-2209-12871.creator: Dhruv Patel, Deep Ray, Michael R A Abdelmalik, Thomas J R Hughes, Assad A Oberai
arxiv-2209-12871.description: Abstract In recent years operator networks have emerged as promising deep learning tools for approximating the solution to partial differential equations (PDEs). These networks map input functions that describe material properties, forcing functions and boundary data to the solution of a PDE.

arxiv-2408-07463.title: A novel framework for quantifying nominal outlyingness
arxiv-2408-07463.creator: Efthymios Costa, Ioanna Papatsouma
arxiv-2408-07463.description: Abstract Outlier detection is an important data mining tool that becomes particularly challenging when dealing with nominal data. First and foremost, flagging observations as outlying requires a well-defined notion of nominal outlyingness. This paper presents a definition of nominal outlyingness and introduces a general framework for quantifying outlyingness of nominal data.

arxiv-2412-08009.title: FLRONet: Deep Operator Learning for High-Fidelity Fluid Flow Field Reconstruction from Sparse Sensor Measurements
arxiv-2412-08009.creator: Hiep Vo Dang, Joseph B. Choi, Phong C. H. Nguyen
arxiv-2412-08009.description: Abstract Reconstructing high-fidelity fluid flow fields from sparse sensor measurements is vital for many science and engineering applications but remains challenging because of dimensional disparities between state and observational spaces. Due to such dimensional differences, the measurement operator becomes ill-conditioned and non-invertible, making the reconstruction of flow fields from sensor measurements extremely difficult.

arxiv-2503-04994.title: Quantifying and Modeling Driving Styles in Trajectory Forecasting Thanks: *Equal Contribution. The authors are with the Department of Computer Science, University of Maryland at College Park, MD, U.S.A. E-mails: {lyzheng,yaghoubi,tonywu,sandeept,tianyi,lin}@umd.edu
arxiv-2503-04994.creator: Laura Zheng*, Hamidreza Yaghoubi Araghi*, Tony Wu
arxiv-2503-04994.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Laura Zheng*, Hamidreza Yaghoubi Araghi*, Tony Wu. Trajectory forecasting has become a popular deep learning task due to its relevance for scenario simulation for autonomous driving. Specifically, trajectory forecasting predicts the trajectory of a short-horizon future for specific human drivers in a particular traffic scenario. Robust and accurate future predictions can enable autonomous driving planners to optimize for low-risk and predictable outcomes for human drivers around them.

arxiv-2505-19455.title: MM-Prompt: Cross-Modal Prompt Tuning for Continual Visual Question Answering
arxiv-2505-19455.creator: Fan Lyu
arxiv-2505-19455.description: Abstract Continual Visual Question Answering (CVQA) based on pre-trained models (PTMs) has achieved promising progress by leveraging prompt tuning to enable continual multi-modal learning. However, most existing methods adopt cross-modal prompt isolation, constructing visual and textual prompts separately, which exacerbates modality imbalance and leads to degraded performance over time.

pmc-11430701.title: Dosimetric and Clinical Prognostic Factors in Single-Isocenter Linac-Based Stereotactic Radiotherapy for Brain Metastases
pmc-11430701.creator: Valeria Faccenda, Riccardo Ray Colciago, Sofia Paola Bianchi, Elena De Ponti, Denis Panizza, Stefano Arcangeli
pmc-11430701.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Recent technological advancements have enabled the replacement of whole-brain radiotherapy with localized stereotactic radiotherapy (SRT) for treating up to 10 BM, either as a primary or combined treatment, reducing neurotoxicity and improving local control (LC).

pmc-12574954.title: Structures of vesicular stomatitis virus glycoprotein G alone and bound to a neutralizing antibody
pmc-12574954.creator: Marie Minoves, Malika Ouldali, Laura Belot, Stéphane Roche, Sarah Johari, Magali Noiray, Eleftherios Zarkadas, Guy Schoehn, Yves Gaudin, Aurélie A. Albertini, Benhur Lee, Benhur Lee
pmc-12574954.description: VSV G mediates viral entry via endocytosis. In the endosome, G undergoes a pH-dependent conformational change from pre- to post-fusion state, catalyzing membrane fusion. No complete structure of G has been reported so far. We present cryo-EM structures of G, isolated from virions using detergent, alone and in complex with the broadly neutralizing antibody 8G5F1 that binds all G conformations.

pmc-12585451.title: Inhibition of Voltage-Gated Sodium Channels by Animal Toxins
pmc-12585451.creator: Shane Gonen
pmc-12585451.description: Voltage-gated sodium channels (NaVs) play important roles in propagating action potentials and their structure and function can be modulated by a variety of factors, including animal toxins. Despite recent technological advances, channel and toxin structural studies still present many challenges. We used cryogenic electron microscopy (CryoEM) to study the tetrodotoxin-resistant human NaV 1.
